technical.summary: ABBV shows strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83+, Stoch 88) combined with weak ADX trend strength and lack of fresh crossover signals suggest elevated pullback risk—better suited for profit-taking or waiting for consolidation entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 73 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale $50-100K, 1 sale $15-50K, 1 small purchase) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.24) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; earnings in 73 days adds moderate event risk but not imminent.
